accepted.evidence: Andersen's i- 'to go' head explicitly compares RV eti and Pali eti. Turner 2515 ḗti 'goes' identifies √i, cites Pali ēti and exact Ashokan eti. The source head is the verbal root-stem label for this inherited family.

Andersen's vas- 'live, stay' head explicitly compares RV vasati and Pali vasati and cross-references vāsin-/vivas-. Turner 11435 vásati 'stays, dwells' identifies √vas, cites Pali vasati and exact Ashokan vasati. This is the same inherited verbal family.

held.reason: Andersen's adjacent su- head is the unrelated prefix 'well, very' (RV/Pali su), not the hearing verb. Turner 12598 is excluded for this homograph; no exact standalone prefix parent is selected in this pass.
